lines.text: What's with all the semicolons?

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: Huh? What the heck is going on?

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: I'm not sending those;;

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: They make it look like my phone's sweating too!
I see.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: Coach, are you busy?
No.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: Could you help me pick out a swimsuit?
Swimsuit?

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: Yeah. The past few days have been real scorchers,

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: so I want to dunk myself in the pool on days when we have no training sessions.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: But I'm not sure what kind of swimsuit I should buy;;
Rash guard.
Bikini.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: A rash guard?

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: I feel like I'd still be burning up wearing that, even in cold water;;;

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: I was leaning towards a bikini too,

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: but I heard two-pieces are forbidden;;;

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: I'll play it safe and go with a one piece.
Are you still taking those supplements?

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: As if you had to ask!

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: They're a must!

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: They introduced a new one, and I've got it as well.
What kind?

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: Apparently, they're able to reduce your body temperature

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: if you take some before swimming.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: Since I just want to try them out, I went with ten boxes.
Ten boxes?

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: That's only enough for one month.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: If they end up working, I'll send you some!
No thanks.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: Aw c'mon! Give it a shot!
Nope.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: Gosh, it's really sweltering today;;;

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: I can't take it anymore! I've gotta go take a dip.

lines.speaker: folkwang
lines.text: I'll catch you later, Coach.
